Bugs

mediumBUG-01

Badge placement depends on the coexisting cre-t-202 test

What happens
The order: 3 / order: 4 rules in va3.css are scoped to body.cre-t-272.cre-t-202, and va3.js appends the badge to the end of #orderForm. When cre-t-202 is not on body, the badge jumps to the top of the Buy Box, directly under “The WinkBed” title, and the financing block moves with it.
Evidence
The code makes the dependency certain: without cre-t-202 on body, no order rule applies to the badge. Removing the class on the live page moved the badge under the product title in the first Chrome recon, one Chrome spec run, and on Safari and Pixel 5 (see screenshot). In other runs it stayed in place, so it depends on how the rest of the Buy Box settles. Every load today has cre-t-202, so visitors don’t see this yet. The risk is if WIN202 is paused or ended, or a visitor isn’t bucketed into it.
Suggested fix
Insert the badge at its real spot in the DOM so it doesn’t rely on another test’s flex order:
// va3.js
var finSelector = "#orderForm .order-form__financing-buy-box-container";
waitForElement(finSelector, init, 50, 15000);
...
document.querySelector(finSelector).insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", hsaEligibilityMarkup);
lowBUG-02

Letter-spacing does not match the financing copy

What happens
The ticket asks for font styles that exactly match the “buy now, pay later” copy. Family, size, weight, line-height and colour all match, but the financing text has letter-spacing: 0.187px and the badge has normal.
Evidence
TC-05 computed styles: financing 0.187px, badge normal.
Suggested fix
Give the badge text the same letter-spacing:
html body.cre-t-272 .cre-t-272-hsa-text {
    letter-spacing: 0.187px;
}
